messages.content: Return one JSON object only, with no code fences, with "primary_topic", "topics" and "tracking_numbers". Topics: status_question, delay, return, damage, address_change, claim_followup, billing, other. Return tracking numbers as a plain list of strings exactly as written in the message.

Hello,

I got an SMS that my parcel from Nile Loom was delivered today, but I was at work and nobody at home has it. When I put the number in your tracking page it says the number is not valid. The number is BYL260411872, I copied it from the shop's email.

Can you tell me who received it and where it was left?

Thanks,
Tarek
